Name: Modest Food Retexture
Author: mkm0312
Description:
I made this personally, but thought I'd share it since it's a good opportunity.
This is a retexture mod for some dishes.

Included in this mod

Blueberry Tart
Pumpkin Pie
Plum pudding
Rice pudding
Chocolate Cake
Ice cream
Blackberry cobbler
Artichoke dip
Maple bar
Omelets
Vegetable medley
Fish stew
Pancake
Crab Cakes
Bruschetta
Escargot
Pink Cake

Each texture can be toggled by config to use or not use, and can also be toggled in-game if [size=3][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/size][/size] is installed.
Some items also have variations.

Variations

Fish stew
Tomatoes are used as an ingredient, so there are red stew and white stew.
Default: white

Vegetable Medley
In Japanese environment, Vegetable Medley is translated as Vegetable Stew. So I made a red stew with tomatoes and beets. Later, I realized the difference between "vegetable medley" and "vegetable stew" and hurriedly made it again. However, since I was so excited, I decided to include both.
Default: Vegetable Medley

Blackberry cobbler,Pumpkin Pie,BluBerryTart
You can switch between the cut and the older version.
Default:New

The text is machine translated.
If you find any mistakes or funny points, please let me know in the posting section. Have fun!
